reviewSamples.author: Photo of M R
reviewSamples.text: George is kind, friendly, and his energy is so calming! My dog hates having her nails cut but she wasn’t stressed at all with George! She literally just laid there, I was stunned. (She acts insane with me. Ha!) Worth the $ to give her a good experience without the drama.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of L S
reviewSamples.text: George was very personable and the facility was spotless.  He listened to what we wanted and the price was very reasonable.  We have tried several groomers and have been disappointed with the quality of care at a much higher price.
